user_query: I'm planning a vacation to Bali and I need to convert 1000 AUD to IDR. Can you provide me with the current exchange rate and the converted amount? Also, I would like to know the exchange rate between SGD and IDR.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current exchange rate from AUD to IDR.
Convert 1000 AUD to IDR using the retrieved exchange rate.
Fetch the current exchange rate from SGD to IDR.
